_env_setup.why: EXPO_PUBLIC_* values resolve to null at build time unless registered as EAS-managed environment variables (local .env only covers `expo start`). A missing value silently ships a build that cannot reach the backend — this is the Mapbox blank-map class of bug.
_env_setup.how_to_register: Run `eas env:create --name EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL --value <url> --visibility plaintext --environment development,preview,production` (repeat per variable), or set them in the EAS Dashboard > Project > Environment Variables. Use the SAME values as lmc-app/.env. Only the Supabase anon key (RLS-protected) and the public Mapbox pk.* token are safe to ship; the MAPBOX_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN (sk.*) is build-only and must stay secret.
_env_setup.note: EAS-managed env vars are auto-injected into every build, so they are intentionally NOT duplicated as literals here (that would leak/override). The `environment` key per profile selects which EAS env set is pulled in.
